introText: Ghost Tequila functions as a creative catalyst, fueling spicy cocktail invention, social UGC, and influencer collaborations. Media spotlights and headline-worthy stunts have reinforced its status as the go-to “make it spicy” spirit.

stats.label: Record Stunt
stats.trend: Miami Beach event; World Red Eye coverage

highlights.title: Cocktails
highlights.description: The Perfectly Spicy Margarita became a signature recipe featured in lifestyle media, while bartenders and bloggers riff with Bloody Marias, spicy Palomas, and more.

highlights.title: UGC
highlights.description: Home bartenders share bottle-and-cocktail shots tagged #ghosttequila; the brand frequently reposts and highlights fans who “got ghosted.”

highlights.title: Influencers
highlights.description: A collaboration with cocktail star Bad Birdy delivered a Halloween 2023 signature drink promoted across both audiences.

highlights.title: Media
highlights.description: Maxim spotlighted Ghost among top tequilas; Forbes, Gear Patrol, and VinePair reinforce its role as the spicy pick and cover product momentum.

highlights.title: Record Stunt
highlights.description: In May 2024, Ghost staged the world’s largest spicy margarita in Miami Beach, generating photo galleries and social buzz around Cinco de Mayo.

closingText: From signature recipes to a record-setting margarita, Ghost converts heat into cultural momentum. It now anchors the conversation where tequila meets spice.
